checks: Insertion marker is hidden initially and stays outside the saved widget lists
Dragging to the start shows a full-width line while keeping the list stable until drop
Drop hides the line and saves only widget IDs in their new order
Middle insertion line is centred in the chosen gap without moving cards yet
Cancelled native drag hides the line and restores the previous order
Dragging to the end marks the final insertion gap while preserving list geometry
Dropping a widget at its existing position clears the line without saving an unchanged layout
Forbidden target area removes the line and cannot commit the tentative move
Leaving the editor clears the insertion marker and cancels an invalid drop
Failed AJAX save clears the marker and rolls the moved widget back
Touch drag shows the insertion line in an empty allowed area
Touch release saves the move with CSRF and removes the line
Cancelled touch gesture restores order and hides the marker
Lost pointer capture also clears the marker and rolls back the tentative move
